arguments.code:
async ({ shell: { exec } }) => exec(`set -e
gh api repos/cv/pi-action/commits/$(git rev-parse main)/pulls --jq '.[0].body // ""' | tr -d '\\r' \
  | awk '/^## Release notes[[:space:]]*$/ { found = 1; next } found && /^## / { exit } found' > /tmp/notes.md
printf '\\n**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/compare/v2.5.0...v2.5.1\\n' >> /tmp/notes.md
cat /tmp/notes.md
gh release create v2.5.1 --draft --verify-tag --title v2.5.1 --notes-file /tmp/notes.md
git tag --force --annotate v2 --message v2 $(git rev-parse main)
git push --force origin refs/tags/v2 2>&1 | tail -3
git ls-remote --tags origin 'v2' 'v2^{}'`, { timeoutMs: 60000 })
arguments.label: Create the v2.5.1 draft release and move the v2 tag manually
